intro.text: An Azish guardsman serving Prime Aqasix Yanagawn the First.

items.text: Vono sailed on the ship carrying Yanagawn, Noura and other Azish dignitaries to Thaylen City.

When the Azish delegation decided to leave Thaylen City before the battle, Vono was told to guard Lift in her cabin so she couldn't join the fight. She kicked him in the groin and hid him under her bunk just before the ship left port.

Once he recovered, with the ship underway, Vono reported Lift's escape to Yanagawn and Noura. Yanagawn was angry but avoided shaming him, and was thinking of turning back when word came that Amaram's Sadeas troops had switched sides and were attacking the city.

appearance.text: He has light brown skin. He keeps proper etiquette before the Prime, though his speech is informal.
